summary.en: Ran is scouted as a model for a painting by Ryuji Kasuga. That day, Conan accompany Ran because he is worried. Later, he senses something from the garden. While he is investigating, he meets the gardener, who mentioned that something has happened with two previous models. Attempted Murder (Past) Victim: Ayu Nagahata Method: Pushing from stairs Suspects: Ryuji Kasuga After being Kasuga's first model, she suddenly was pushed from a staircase. Attempted Murder (Past) Victim: Machiko Nogami Method: Pushing into traffic Suspects: Ryuji Kasuga After being Kasuga's second model, she is pushed to the street and attacked. Both models were pushed around the same place where Kasuga scouted them, and they admit that they saw Kasuga on the day of incident. Machiko recalls that she heard a clattering sound. Meanwhile, Yoshio is searching something in Kasuga's late wife's room, and he finds some photos of Kasuga and his wife taken at some specific places. At the same time, Kasuga is finishing Ran's potrait painting. Conan then tells Kogoro that the garderner revealed that Kasuga's wife passed away six months ago and he was depressed and could not enter his studio. After a while, he found some models and start painting, but both models end up being attacked by someone on their way home on the day the painting was finished. After hearing that, they quickly run to Kasuga's house.
